page.layout: One page of text, with two round portrait medallions at the top centre above the text (no column of notes); running head across the top. Medallions are illustrations, not text, and are described under notes. Text in one full-width block below.

main_text.l: D. AMBROSIVS in Gallia sub Côstantij imperio natus
fuit, patre Symmacho, præfecto Galliæ. Infanti in prætoria do-
mo dormienti, apes circaos visæ sunt oberrare: patre, impubes
amisit, inde cum matre & sorore Marcellina Romam profectus
ibi studiis sese addixit: & tandē causas agere cœpit. Mox à Pro-
bo prætorij præfecto, consiliorū & gubernationis socius fuit ad-
scitus. Consulari posteā dignitate insignitus, ad regendā Ligu-
riā missus est à Probo. Mortuo Auxentio Mediolanensi Episco-
po, fuit is à populo, Episcopus electus: renuit illud munus: sed
Imperator populi electione delectatus, eā confirmat. Elegitur
in Episcopū, anno Christi 378. sub Damaso Papa. Plurima scrip-
sit: contra omnes fere hæreses acriter pugnauit. Præfuit Episco-
patui, annis 22. obiit anno Christi 400. Arcadij & Honorij ter-
tio, senex admodū. Claruit sub Theodosio Imper. [|] domini 380.
D. AVGVSTINVS, matre Monica, patre Patricio in ci-
tate Thaguftensi natus, Christianus quidē, sed mediocri fortu-
na. In pueritia à matre de Christo institutus est, sed baptismus
dilatus. Apueris ludū frequentauit, præceptore Manlio Theo-
doro. Manichæorū opinionem diu sectatus est. Romæ docuit
Rhetoricā: inde Mediolanū accersitus, sensimà Manichæis de-
fecit, cū Ambrosij cōciones diligēter audiret, & ad religionem
Christianā transiit, & suscepit baptismū cum Alipio, & naturali
filio Adeodato, natus annos 33. post Maximi tyranni mortem.
Domū inde in Africā rediit, & in agris suis vixit. Mox Hippo-
nensis ecclesiæ presbyter à Valerio ordinatus, & tandē etiā eius
coëpiscopus. Eo mortuo ad Episcopatū euectus est, quē sanctissimē
& factis & cōcionibus & scriptis administrauit. Cōtra hæ-
reticos accerrimē disputauit. Donatistarū secta multū ei nego-
tij exhibuit: cū mulieribus, necognatis quidē, ppter suspicionē,
nō habitauit. Veftitu mūdo, mēsa frugali vtebatur, & vino. Tandē
præsente Possidonio & aliis piè in Domino obdormiuit, cū vi-
xisset annos 76. anno mūdi 4395. Christ. 434. in ecclesiastica fūctio-
ne 40. Huius vitā Possidonius Calamēsis episcopus descripsit.

page.notes: Two circular portrait medallions above the text. Left: a bald, bearded man in profile-to-front view, with the inscription "S. AMBROSIVS" on the left rim and "EPISC. MEDIOL." on the right rim. Right: a bearded man in front view with long curly hair, inscription "S. AVGVSTINVS" on the left rim and "CARTHAG." on the right rim. These are engraved illustrations, not printed text beyond the rim inscriptions. Running head reads "AD PROMPTV. ICONVM" with the word split into "AD" and "PROMPTV." as printed; the scan has a faint and partly lost letter in "PROMPTV." and in "ICONVM" the letters are spaced. Page number "406" printed at top left, partly smudged; the first digit is faint and may be a 4 or a different figure; read as printed. Doubtful readings: "Côstantij" (the tilde over o is faint); "[|]" in "Theodosio Imper. [|] domini" is a stray mark, possibly a printed bar or a dividing sign; "Thaguftensi" and "Calamēsis" as printed; "Hipponensis" as printed. Printing errors left as printed: "sensimà", "ppter", "necognatis" and "mudi" forms, "ecclesiaftica fūctione" with a stray ū, "Veftitu", "Mediolanensi" printed with "Mediolanesi". Line "Christ. 434." and "anno mūdi 4395." run within the paragraph as printed.
